text:
incident-bot: ALERT: KV blockmgr metadata growth > 80% on us-west-2-pool-3. Continuous-batch rate increased 3.6x. Auto-eviction triggered.

alex: seeing a steady metadata_count increase on paged-kv. Evictions are happening but metadata doesn't shrink.

priya: confirmed — metric kv_blockmgr.metadata_entries_total spiked ~22:14 UTC and hasn't dropped. Latency SLOs for short-sequence requests at 99 p95 are climbing.

mike: any customer 503s?

jessica: yes — support ticket #CS-1321 reports intermittent 503s for embedding calls since ~22:10. Affected tenant: badger-analytics (dedicated).

alex: putting initial triage: 1) throttle continuous batching 2) force aggressive eviction 3) check block size misconfig.

priya: good. Adding runbook pointer: sre-runbook-bot, what's recommended?

sre-runbook-bot: runbook: KV metadata leak / paged blockmgr -> Priority mitigation steps: reduce continuous_batch_window, set blockmgr.eviction_policy=age_lru, temporarily disable prefix caching, capture heap and blockmgr stats. See: https://internal/runbooks/kv/blockmgr-metadata-leak

mike: I'll capture heap + blockmgr snapshot now. Running: 
```
curl -s http://localhost:9091/debug/vars | jq '.blockmgr, .metadata'
> saving to /tmp/blockmgr_snapshot_2450012345.json
```

alex: before we change anything, small canary: apply eviction_policy=age_lru to a single canary node in us-west-2-pool-3. Deploy-bot, can you patch one instance?

deploy-bot: starting canary patch: svc/blockmgr@us-west-2-pool-3-node-7 -> set env BLOCKMGR_EVICTION=age_lru, restart svc.

jessica: pushing on support — telling customer we have a mitigation in flight; they asked if this is correlated to yesterday's model rollouts. Not seeing a direct link yet.

priya: while canary patches, reduce continuous batching window from 200ms -> 20ms for all pools to reduce batch coalescing. That should lower metadata churn. Who can apply?

mike: I'll roll that out cluster-wide via config override. Command: 
```
kubectl -n redwood set env cm/blocking-config CONT_BATCH_WINDOW_MS=20 --record
```
Applying to staging first.

alex: staging looks good for 5m. No regression on throughput. Rolling to prod now.

(5m later)

mike: prod rollout done. We see continuous-batch rate drop ~65%. Metadata growth has slowed but hasn't reversed.

jessica: support: customer sees reduced errors but still occasional spikes. Ticket updated.

priya: canary eviction_policy change result?

deploy-bot: canary node us-west-2-pool-3-node-7 returned to steady state. metadata_entries on that node dropped ~40% in 2 minutes.

alex: that's promising. Let's promote eviction_policy to pool. But don't yet change block size. We'll keep conservative.

mike: promoting eviction policy across pool now. Command: 
```
for node in $(nodes -l pool=us-west-2-pool-3); do ssh $node 'sudo systemctl restart blockmgr --env BLOCKMGR_EVICTION=age_lru'; done
```
Rollout in progress (staggered).

(10m later)

mike: rollout complete. Global metadata entries decreasing slowly. Latency improved p95 -> down 120ms. Still slightly above baseline.

priya: we should also patch a bug in the blockmgr that prevents metadata pruning when blocks are freed; looks like a fastpath skip introduced in revision fd3a2c. Who has bandwidth for a hotfix?

alex: I can handle hotfix. I'll prepare a minimal change to ensure freed blocks always decrement metadata counter. Need quick review.

jessica: notify customers of expected maintenance window to apply hotfix? They asked for ETA.

alex: aiming for 30m deploy for hotfix with canary. Pushing to feature branch: fd3a2c-metadata-fix.

(30m later)

alex: CL uploaded and CI green. Deploying canary.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for svc/blockmgr fd3a2c-metadata-fix -> us-west-2-pool-3-node-9.

mike: monitoring metrics: blockmgr.metadata_entries on canary node shows proper decrement after eviction events. Heap stable. No increased CPU.

priya: good. Schedule full rollout during low-traffic window but we may need immediate full deploy if leak persists.

jessica: support updated customers: scheduled hotfix in 45m, can opt-in early for minimal downtime.

alex: rolling to full pool now with 30s stagger between nodes.

(12m later)

mike: rollout complete. Post-deploy metrics: total metadata_entries down 72% from peak, eviction_count normalized. Request errors 503 -> reduced to baseline.

jessica: customer CS-1321 confirms errors largely resolved. They saw >95% success after hotfix.

priya: root cause summary for incident notes: regression introduced in fd3a2c where an optimization skipped decrementing metadata counter during certain eviction fastpaths when block size != default. With continuous batching spike, metadata growth amplified into pool-wide blowup. Mitigations applied: 1) reduced continuous batch window 2) switched eviction policy to age_lru 3) deployed hotfix to ensure metadata counter consistency 4) added additional metrics and alert thresholds for metadata growth by pool.

alex: follow-ups: - add e2e test that exercises block free + metadata counter paths - add automatic circuit (disable continuous batching) when metadata growth > 50% over 5m - postmortem doc (assign owner: priya)

priya: assigning postmortem to myself. Will draft and link to incident page.

mike: saved all diagnostics to internal S3: s3://redwood-diagnostics/2450012345-blockmgr-metadata-drip/

incident-bot: INCIDENT: resolved -> status: mitigated. Please file postmortem within 72h.

jessica: thanks team. I'll close the customer loop and mark ticket resolved pending postmortem. :thumbsup:

alex: handing off to next oncall (mike) for monitoring until metrics stable for 2h.

mike: ack — I'll watch and escalate if anything regresses.

(Last note)

mike: FYI, saving capture: /tmp/blockmgr_snapshot_2450012345.json and additional heap dumps in S3. If you need anything else ping me.
